newsitem.title: YEMEN: Four killed in more Yemen election violence.
newsitem.headline: Four killed in more Yemen election violence.

text.p: Four people were killed on Tuesday when supporters of Yemen's ruling General People's Congress (GPC) and its Islamist junior coalition partner exchanged fire in the latest violence to mar parliamentary elections, a security official said on Wednesday.

The official said the shooting erupted in the governorate of Hajja northwest of Sanaa in a dispute over vote counting between members of the GPC and the Islah party. The official said an investigation was underway to find out more details.
